mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 6.5% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals labor market deterioration that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction (HOUST) and real consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates broad-based demand contraction, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial production contraction (INDPRO < 95.0), a decline in manufacturing output signals recessionary supply shock, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real consumer spending (RSAFS) over the past 3 months signals strong demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS increases for 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% and remains above this level for three consecutive months, restrictive monetary policy depresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high unemployment (UNRATE > 7.0%), a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals worsening labor conditions, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 7.0% and PAYEMS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates severe labor market deterioration, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both UNRATE rises and PAYEMS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
